meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速制作并渲染视频动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量生成视频内容
copy.tagline_en: Create and render video animations quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate video content in batches

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 HyperFrames 命令行制作视频：先初始化项目，查找现成动效来复用，编写并预览动画，跑 lint 和 check 检查，经你批准后渲染成 mp4，再验证文件存在且时长正常。
howto.when: 当你请它制作或渲染视频/动画、添加动效，或排查构建与渲染失败时，它会进入这条 CLI 流程。

say.text: 帮我做一个标题逐字显现的开场动画
say.note: 它会在目录里找现成动效，选中后复制进项目。

say.text: 先给这个 hyperframes 项目跑一遍 lint 和 check
say.note: 它会按流程先 lint，再在浏览器里做最终检查。

say.text: 把预览过的视频按高清渲染成 out.mp4
say.note: 渲染前会停住等你确认，批准后才执行。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude builds videos through the HyperFrames CLI: scaffold, search reusable motion, author and preview, run lint/check gates, render mp4 after approval, and verify the output file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create or render a video/animation, add motion, or diagnose build/render failures.

say_en.text: Make an opening where each title line reveals one by one.
say_en.note: It searches the catalog for a suitable motion and installs it.

say_en.text: Run lint and check on this hyperframes project.
say_en.note: It lints first, then runs the browser-based final gate.

say_en.text: Render the previewed video to out.mp4 at high quality.
say_en.note: It waits for approval, then renders and verifies the output.
